name: @touch/operator-shell
description: Electron shell for the Touch Padel operator app: SQLite durable queue, LAN KDS server, heartbeat, printing, kiosk.

scripts.dist: pnpm --filter @touch/operator build && node esbuild.config.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:dir: pnpm --filter @touch/operator build && node esbuild.config.mjs && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.yml

x-notes: CommonJS on purpose (no "type": "module"): Electron main/preload compile to CJS — the monorepo-wide ESM rule's one exception.
sharp is deliberately NOT installed: the print pipeline thresholds Chromium BGRA captures in plain JS (src/main/print/raster.ts).
electron-builder + electron-updater are added when operator-release.yml lands (design-arch.md 8); config already drafted in electron-builder.yml.
Auto-update scheduling machinery is CUT from phase 1 (plan cut #7) — plain electron-updater only, no update windows.
